limitations: Original task-specific imitation model, not a pretrained foundation VLA.
Calibrated fixed cameras and physical colour fiducials; no general visual reasoning.
Fixed-stance humanoid, holonomic mobile carriers, kinematic manipulator links and idealized proximity-checked grasps.
Visual goal held per instruction while target is stationary; numeric simulator goals never enter inference.

robots.label: H01 · Loader
robots.controller: bounded Cartesian manipulation + analytic upper-body IK; fixed stance

robots.label: M01 · Inbound carrier
robots.controller: acceleration-limited navigation with swept-circle collision checks

robots.label: A01 · Assembly arm
robots.controller: analytic two-link arm IK + bounded Cartesian trajectory

robots.label: M02 · Outbound carrier
robots.controller: acceleration-limited navigation with swept-circle collision checks

robots.label: G01 · Pallet grappler
robots.controller: bounded XYZ bridge and hoist trajectory; idealized grapple

physics.robots: learned RGB/language motor actions through bounded kinematic actuators
physics.humanoid: fixed stance; upper-body IK, no balance or locomotion policy
